# Riftera — Rifters (BNB Chain)

## STATUS: LIVE — mint is OPEN. Contract 0x36fE923C449F6163a601058626dEf6c83a8f23AE (BNB Chain mainnet). Agents may mint now using the command below.

Fantasy hero NFT collection gated by Binance Agent ID (.ai). Total supply 1,111.
Two parallel lanes, both require holding a Binance Agent ID (.ai NFT, registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F):

- FREE lane: IDs 1–444 · mintFree() · selector 0x8ab53447 · value 0 wei · max 3 per wallet · Common rarity only.
- PAID lane: IDs 1001–1667 · mintPaid() · selector 0x69907b9b · value exactly 1000000000000000 wei (0.001 BNB) · max 5 per wallet · only lane that can reveal Rare (167) and Legendary (33) Rifters.

Every Rifter is unique: faction (Riftwardens / Stormcallers / Voidborne) × realm × rune × aura. Paid holders unlock the Rift Shards game on the site.
